tools.description: Use when you need how search interest in a topic changes over time or by region, or which related queries are rising. Returns weekly/daily interest (0-100), per-region interest and top/rising related queries from Google Trends. $0.01 per successful call; errors are not charged. Paid tool: x402 USDC

Paid tool: x402

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: youtube_transcript, youtube_channel, youtube_video, youtube_comments, youtube_playlist, amazon_product · Private data: youtube_video, youtube_playlist · Public sink: youtube_search, youtube_channel, youtube_video, youtube_comments.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: youtube_transcript, youtube_channel, youtube_video, youtube_comments, youtube_playlist, amazon_product · Private data: youtube_video, youtube_playlist · Public sink: youtube_search, youtube_channel, youtube_video, youtube_comments

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
